## Claims
- [source-backed] The 2011 paper conjectures minimality of both Theorem 5.4 generating sets for \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\). [source-6, lines 14-16]
- [source-backed] The stronger, distinct statement is \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}/\Lambda_+J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\). [source-6, lines 56-72]
- [source-backed] The escalated DOI candidate is St. Dizier–Yong (2024), *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety: Proof of the minimality conjecture*; its abstract says “We prove the minimality conjecture.” [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832]

## Strategy
The DOI metadata automatically identifies the exact 2024 candidate. A bounded theorem-text certificate must contain the theorem statement, hypotheses/definitions identifying the two Theorem 5.4 families, coefficient ring, and any statement concerning indecomposables.

## Gaps
No FULL-TEXT SOURCE block or numbered theorem passage for DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832` was supplied. Thus the bounded theorem-text certificate cannot be executed from the available sources. The requested minimality target is **not established** at theorem level, and the stronger integral indecomposables claim is likewise unestablished.
